label: Whichever single sense potency takes, nothing moves itself in the same respect
description: Optional summary over POTENCY_1-3. Coverage reads both uses of 'in potency' (what is moved is in potency; nothing is in act and in potency) in selected senses among ADOPTED, INDEPENDENT and CAPACITY; exclusivity makes them one sense. Whichever it is, a self-mover in a respect in which it is moved would be in potency there in that one sense and in act there, which non-simultaneity excludes. The controls give the mixed reading (moved use CAPACITY, non-simultaneity ADOPTED) with self-motion.
